title: Victoria Arduino Eagle One
content_summary:
Eagle One was created in response to the new generation of cafeterias wheredesign,performance, andsustainabilityare determining factors in creating an enjoyable and memorable experience.

Neo

TERS

EasyCream

VIS (Intelligent VirtualScale)

Neo

NEO stands for New Engine Optimization. The new engine concept optimizes boilers and uses an instantaneous heating system, allowing only the amount of water needed for extraction to be heated, thus using less water. Productivity and performance remain constant, while energy efficiency increases.

TERS

The patented TERS (Temperature Energy

Recovery System) allows waste water to be used to preheat incoming water, using a process to recycle and minimize waste with a savings of 8 percent of total machine consumption.

EasyCream

Easy Cream Technology enables automatic frothing of milk and plant-based beverages at the right temperature and with the right amount of foam, allowing up to 2 recipes to be customized in terms of temperature, consistency and foam results.

VIS (Intelligent VirtualScale)

V.I.S. is a Victoria Arduino technology developed to digitally estimate the right cup dose through an algorithmic calculation. V.I.S. improves workflow and the certainty of great extraction by making Eagle One an even better performing and smarter system.

Design

Minimal, simple and sophisticated design adaptable to different styles and layouts. For the shape of the Eagle One, Victoria Arduino was not only inspired by its impressive history, but also focused on the needs of new-age cafeterias that demand compact, efficient, and sustainable machines while still expressing their own personality

Sustainability

Sustainability inspired the entire Eagle One project. For the new generation of baristas, having a high-performance machine in terms of efficiency and energy savings is essential.

The Eagle One remains more compact than previous machines in its class. Compact size means more logistical advantages (since it easily fits into any space, even the smallest), profitability and energy efficiency. A smaller machine has, in fact, less heat loss.

Eagle One Special Edition

Victoria Arduino has created a new concept of an espresso machine that goes beyond technology, becoming a true expression of art and design culture. The Eagle One Special Edition is the culmination of this vision: exclusive pieces created for those seeking uniqueness, design and meaning.

title: Nuova Aurelia
content_summary:
The Nuova Aurelia coffee machine enables an unprecedented smooth workflow thanks to responsive technology, ensuring high-quality consistency in the cup. This means happier baristas, more satisfied customers, and increased productivity.

Why NUOVA?Nuova has always been the word that expresses the pursuit of innovation, so fundamental to Nuova Simonelli.Nuova Aurelia stands out as the masterpiece of our tech-for-human ideal: our mission is to create the smartest coffee machine, as well as the most intuitive to use.

E-Milk is Nuova Simonelli’s most advanced milk frothing system, designed to provide perfect foam for both cow and plant-based milk beverages with a single gesture.

The system allows up to 9 customizable recipes, selected via an intuitive electronic knob. Its wand, made of cool-touch material, integrates sensors that detect the presence of milk and automatically start the frothing process.

Once completed, it performs an automatic purge, maintaining hygiene and reducing downtime.

C-Automation connects the espresso machine and grinder into an intelligent ecosystem. Each color-coded portafilter is associated with a recipe: once inserted, the grinder automatically dispenses the correct dose, and the machine automatically selects the correct buttons and executes the associated recipe.

The system automatically adjusts the grind and controls the coffee extraction flow, ensuring consistently excellent results. This way, workflow speed can be increased by up to 20% without compromising quality.

SIS optimizes espresso extraction by applying a gentle pre-infusion that evenly saturates the coffee puck, regardless of tamping quality. A constant pressure of 9 bars follows the soft curve start, resulting in richer flavor and crema.

Our MP System uses multiboiler technology with precise temperature control and instant heating, optimizing energy use without compromising performance.

Compact boilers are insulated and coated with innovative materials to prevent heat loss and maximize efficiency. Baristas simply set the temperature—the machine does the rest.

Feature Five

E-Steam delivers high-pressure dry steam through a fully electronic control knob. It ensures temperature stability and steam quality even in busy environments. The knob allows two functions: purge (rotation) and steaming (pressure). If a temperature probe is installed, the knob display shows the real-time temperature.

The next beverage workstation

Nuova Aurelia offers baristas a wider range of drinks that can be prepared automatically and intuitively thanks to a set of easy-to-use co-working technological solutions.

The new all-in-one system includes various coffee extractions, dairy and plant-based milk frothing options, and an innovative automated dialogue between machine and grinder.

Perfect for coffee-oriented and non-coffee-oriented chains, roasteries, restaurants, and hotels.

Energy saving

Nuova Aurelia has been designed to reduce energy dispersion and its carbon footprint, thanks to innovative technologies and careful evaluation of the production process.

INSULATED BOILERS •The boilers are made with a special insulating material to minimize heat dispersion and thus save energy.

WEEKLY PROGRAMMING •Daily on/off setting to reduce consumption.

GROUP SWITCH •Option for low activity periods.

title: 3Temp
content_summary:
DESIGN AND QUALITYDiscover the excellence of Swedish design with3TEMP filter coffee brewers. Known for exceptional quality, innovative engineering, and advanced brewing technology, our machines are built for offices, cafés, and restaurants that demand outstanding coffee.

At 3TEMP, we are passionate about shaping the future of global coffee culture through smart, reliable brewing solutions.

MEET THE 3TEMP PROFILE BREWERSWe aim to simplify the art of brewing exceptional coffee. Our goal is to celebrate coffee’s journey by providing coffee enthusiasts with the perfect tools for each delightful sip. While pour-over brewing brings out coffee’s best, mastering it, especially in bustling cafes, can be challenging. Enter our3TEMP brewers, equipped with IoT technology. Moreover, we remain conscious of the ecological footprint our brewers leave on the world we all cherish.

In essence, we’re here to ensure everyone enjoys a perfect cup every time, shaping a better tomorrow in every brew.

Revolutionizing Energy Efficiency in Brewing

Traditional filter brewers, with their continuous water tank heating, often result in a substantial and steady consumption of energy over time. On average, a conventional batch brewer can devour over 840 kWh annually, primarily to maintain a constant water temperature within the tank.

In contrast, our 3TEMP brewers are pioneers in energy conservation, utilizing approximately27 times less energyby only activating the heating element during the brewing process. This innovative approach means that over the same timeframe and for an equivalent number of brews, 3TEMP brewers consume a mere 30 kWh per year.

One delightful side effect of this energy-saving design is that you consistently use fresh water for brewing, imparting a significantly higher quality and richer taste to your coffee. Make the switch to 3TEMP brewers and not only will you enjoy exceptional coffee, but you’ll also ensure that every cup is a testament to sustainability and exceptional flavor.

3TEMPrevolutionizes coffee brewing with advanced technology and precision engineering.From rich black coffee to creamy lattes and iced drinks, our innovative machines deliver exceptional flavor and consistency every time.

title: Caye Bionic Barista
content_summary:
The Smart X Series commercial fully automatic coffee machinereplicates professional barista craftsmanship with its Bionic Barista system, precisely managing grinding, weighing, tamping, and extraction to deliver consistent, premium-quality coffee for every customer.

Grinding & Weighing

The precision-engineered Constant Particle Size (CPS) ceramic burr grinder, driven by a quiet, high-performance BLDC motor, delivers exceptional grind consistency with particle size variation kept below 40 μm. Its advanced design ensures thermal stability during continuous operation, producing uniform coffee grounds for consistently balanced extraction.
The AccuPowderWeigh™ dosing system provides high-accuracy grind-by-weight control, maintaining each dose within ±0.2 g. This precision creates a reliable foundation for accurate brew ratios, improved flavor consistency, and professional-level coffee quality.

Distribution & Tamping

The coffee grounds are transferred into the brewing chamber in a single, controlled motion, ensuring a uniform coffee bed for improved extraction consistency.
Powered by an advanced Vertical Vibrating Distribution (VVD) system, the machine replicates a professional barista’s portafilter-tapping technique. Precise vertical vibrations evenly redistribute the coffee bed, reducing channeling and delivering stable, repeatable extraction quality with every brew.

Brewing

The reverse gravity extraction and vertical infusion system optimize espresso brewing by maximizing extraction efficiency while maintaining consistent coffee quality in every cup.
The advanced AccuLiquidWeigh™ liquid weighing system goes beyond traditional flow-based measurement, delivering high-precision control over beverage weight and extraction time for superior accuracy and repeatable results.

Milk Frothing

Powered by SuperMix Frothing Technology, milk and air are rapidly blended through a controlled swirling motion, followed by high-pressure steam infusion. This advanced process produces exceptionally dense, silky microfoam, delivering café-quality milk texture that mirrors the precision and craftsmanship of a professional barista.

Creating

Featuring the industry’s first CLS (Closed-Loop System) technology, this fully integrated system continuously monitors both ground coffee weight and liquid extraction weight. By analyzing extraction time in real time, it automatically adjusts grind size to ensure consistent flavor, balanced extraction, and exceptional cup quality — every single time.
.

AccuPowderWeigh™ High-Precision Ground Coffee Weight Control

Engineered for precision in every brew, theAccuPowderWeigh™ systemmaintains ground coffee weight accuracy within±0.2g, even after over300 consecutive grinding cycles. Powered by aC3-level precision scale modulewith0.03% accuracy, it delivers consistent dosing for repeatable, café-quality espresso extraction.

Complete Closed-Loop System (CLS) for Optimal Extraction

Caye’s pioneeringComplete Closed-Loop System (CLS)is the industry’s first true extraction quality control mechanism. This intelligent system continuously monitors and automatically adjuststhree critical parameters—coffee dose, extraction time, and espresso yield— ensuring optimal extraction balance and flavor consistency in every cup.

Continuous Grinding, Consistent Particle Size

The self-developedConstant Particle Size (CPS) ceramic burr grinderis designed for durability and thermal stability during extended operation. By minimizing heat buildup, it ensures uniform grind consistency and preserves flavor integrity throughout high-volume brewing.

Vertical Vibrating Distribution (VVD) for an Even Coffee Bed

TheVertical Vibrating Distribution (VVD) systemmimics a professional barista’s portafilter tapping technique using controlled vertical vibrations. This process evenly levels the coffee bed,prevents channeling, and delivers stable, repeatable espresso extraction with every shot.

Reverse Gravity Extraction & Vertical Infusion

Featuring areverse gravity extraction system, water flows upward through the coffee puck for more uniform saturation. Combined withvertical infusion, this method enhances extraction efficiency, resulting in a consistently rich, balanced, and full-bodied espresso.

title: Victoria Arduino My Series Grinders
content_summary:
Mythos is the professional coffee grinder that changed the rules of coffee grinding.

Mythos was designed to define a new idea of precision and control.

And, to this day, it continues to set new standards for grinding in the coffee industry.

The Mythos Manifesto

Neo

TERS

EasyCream

High production

Neo

New Engine Optimization is a unique technology that enables high performance and improves energy efficiency. All the bartender has to do is set the temperature from the display. The NEO engine uses instantaneous heating technology that requires smaller volumes and boilers because only the water needed is heated.

TERS

The patented TERS (Temperature Energy Recovery System) allows waste water to be used to preheat incoming water, using a process to recycle and minimize waste with a savings of 8 percent of total machine consumption.

EasyCream

Easy Cream technology automatically whips milk and vegetable drinks at the right temperature and with the right amount of foam, allowing you to customize up to 9 recipes and select one directly from the main display of your coffee machine.The barista can create different recipes using different types of milk/alternatives in terms of temperature, consistency, and foam results.

Design

Aesthetics and efficiency: this is our sense of design

The smooth and responsive combination of the integrated glass display and touchscreen creates an intuitive, sliding control panel that is stylish, easy to adjust, and easy to clean.

We were the first to install two fans instead of one, and again the first to mount both at the back. This ensures ideal airflow inside the grinding chamber. Counter space is valuable for coffees. If you need to use several grinders at the same time for different needs, now each grinder can be placed side by side.

Sustainability

Designed by coffee specialists for coffee specialists, Victoria Arduino’s Mythos improves grind quality and coffee flavor while minimizing waste, offering a sustainable solution for professional baristas.

Born to make history

Mythos is not just a product. It is a symbol of a new way of thinking about, working with, and extracting coffee. Since its debut in 2013, it has become a true icon for baristas and specialty coffee shops around the world. Designed in collaboration with the community and shaped by their needs, Mythos has grown as part of the culture surrounding coffee, not outside of it.

From its revolutionary launch to today’s continuous innovation, Mythos is not only part of history-it continues to write it.

2022-2025 WBC Official Sponsor

Chosen as the official coffee grinder of the World Barista Championship, Mythos sets the global standard for grinding precision. With iconic design, unwavering passion, and shared values, it connects with baristas, roasters, and coffee chains around the world – once again raising the bar on what perfection in grinding means.
